title: [Bugs] UPF silently returns Cause=Accepted when RemovePDR fails — stale gtp5g kernel rules persist undetected, enabling traffic policy bypass and kernel resource exhaustion DoS
body: ## Bug Decription A SessionModificationRequest containing a RemovePDR IE referencing a non-existent PDR-ID causes the UPF to log Mod RemovePDR error: RemovePDR: PDR(0x63) not found but return Cause=RequestAccepted. The rule is never removed from gtp5g. Impact: The SMF deletes the PDR from its own session record, believing removal succeeded. In reality the rule remains active in the gtp5g kernel — traffic the SMF considers halted continues to be processed silently. If the same silent failure occurs on a legitimately installed PDR (e.g. due to any internal state mismatch), the stale rule persists indefinitely, constituting a traffic policy bypass: the data plane enforces rules the control plane has explicitly revoked. Repeated exploitation causes unreferenced PDR objects to accumulate in the gtp5g kernel module, progressively exhausting kernel memory and hash-table entries until the UPF becomes unable to install new rules — a resource exhaustion DoS affecting all active sessions system-wide. There is no standard PFCP recovery path once SMF and UPF state have diverged; full service restoration requires association reset, interrupting all concurrent PDU sessions. Root cause (session.go, handleSessionModificationRequest): err = sess.RemovePDR(i) if err != nil { sess.log.Errorf("Mod RemovePDR error: %+v", err) // error discarded — Cause=Accepted returned regardless } ## To Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1.Start free5GC normally. 2.Use the following two files for reproduction: Sender script: [free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_repro.py](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26667748/free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_repro.py) Seed/description file: [free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_seed.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26667749/free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_seed.json) No additional dependencies required (Python 3.8+ standard library only). 3.Run: python3 free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_repro.py ## Expected Behavior When RemovePDR fails, the UPF must return Cause=RuleCreationModificationFailure. Confirming deletion of a rule that is still active in the data plane violates 3GPP TS 29.244 §7.5.4 and enables both traffic policy bypass and kernel resource exhaustion DoS. ## Screenshots ## Environment free5GC Version: v4.2.1] OS: Ubuntu 22.04 Kernel version: normal go version: normal C compiler version (optional): normal ## Trace Files ### Configuration Files version: 1.0.3 description: UPF initial local configuration pfcp: addr: 127.0.0.8 # IP addr for listening nodeID: 127.0.0.8 # External IP or FQDN can be reached retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission ### PCAP File [free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26667775/free5gc_upf_remove_pdr_repro.zip) ### Log File 2026-04-13T06:40:28.221785477Z [INFO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805] handleSessionModificationRequest 2026-04-13T06:40:28.222037353Z [ERRO][UPF][PFCP][LAddr:127.0.0.8:8805][CPNodeID:127.0.0.100][CPSEID:0x6002][UPSEID:0x1] Mod RemovePDR error: RemovePDR: PDR(0x63) not found github.com/free5gc/go-upf/internal/pfcp.(*Sess).RemovePDR /home/fei/free5gc/NFs/upf/internal/pfcp/node.go:221 github.com/free5gc/go-upf/internal/pfcp.(*PfcpServer).handleSessionModificationRequest /home/fei/free5gc/NFs/upf/internal/pfcp/session.go:246 github.com/free5gc/go-upf/internal/pfcp.(*PfcpServer).reqDispacher /home/fei/free5gc/NFs/upf/internal/pfcp/dispacher.go:23 github.com/free5gc/go-upf/internal/pfcp.(*PfcpServer).main /home/fei/free5gc/NFs/upf/internal/pfcp/pfcp.go:156 runtime.goexit /home/fei/go/pkg/mod/golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.25.5.linux-amd64/src/runtime/asm_amd64.s:1693
